A list of spells available to be learned by the Bard class upon level up.

Overview

The level column indicates spell level, not class level. Bard spells are Known spells and cannot be changed after they are learned during through a level up.

Bard spells will use the caster's Charisma modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
